national_baseline_policies.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: Cashless health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: Low-income, rural families and identified urban workers' families as per SECC data.
national_baseline_policies.premium_structure: Fully funded by Central and State Governments.

national_baseline_policies.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: ₹2 Lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹1 Lakh for partial permanent disability.
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: All individual bank account holders aged between 18 and 70 years.

national_baseline_policies.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: Term life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh payable to the nominee upon the death of the insured due to any reason.
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: All individual bank account holders aged between 18 and 50 years.

national_baseline_policies.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: Monthly financial pension assistance ranging from ₹200 to ₹500+ depending on the beneficiary's age bracket.
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).
national_baseline_policies.premium_structure: Fully funded by Government welfare funds.

national_baseline_policies.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: Monthly financial pension assistance of ₹300 for sustenance and living support.
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: BPL widows aged between 40 and 79 years.
national_baseline_policies.premium_structure: Fully funded by Government welfare funds.

national_baseline_policies.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: Monthly financial pension assistance of ₹300 for living support.
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: BPL individuals aged 18-79 with a severe or multiple disability level of 80% or higher.
national_baseline_policies.premium_structure: Fully funded by Government welfare funds.

national_baseline_policies.name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) / Ration Card Schemes
national_baseline_policies.coverage_details: Entitilement to highly subsidized food grains (Rice, Wheat, Coarse grains) distributed via the Public Distribution System (PDS).
national_baseline_policies.target_audience: Priority Households (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) card holders.

policies.name: Chirayu Ayushman Haryana
policies.coverage_details: Cashless medical insurance coverage expanding on the central PMJAY foundation, offering up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year across empanelled hospitals.
policies.target_audience: Families with verified state demographic records falling within designated income categories.
policies.premium_structure: 100% premium paid by the State Government for eligible categories.

policies.name: Old Age Samman Allowance Scheme
policies.coverage_details: Monthly financial assistance allowance of ₹3,000 to senior citizens to maintain livelihood.
policies.target_audience: Domicile residents of Haryana aged 60 years or older whose combined family income is within state guidelines.

policies.name: Swasthya Sathi Scheme
policies.coverage_details: Basic health coverage for secondary and tertiary care up to ₹5 Lakh per family per annum via a smart card issued to the female head of the family.
policies.target_audience: All citizens of West Bengal not covered under any other government health insurance scheme.

policies.name: Khadya Sathi (Ration Card Scheme)
policies.coverage_details: Provision of highly subsidized or free food grains (Rice and Wheat) to targeted digital ration card holders.
policies.target_audience: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Special Priority Households (SPHH) in West Bengal.

policies.name: Lakshmir Bhandar
policies.coverage_details: Direct monthly financial cash transfer support of ₹1,000 for General category and ₹1,200 for SC/ST families.
policies.target_audience: Female heads of households aged between 25 and 60 years.

policies.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
policies.coverage_details: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for designated medical treatments and surgeries across empanelled hospitals.
policies.target_audience: Holders of Yellow/Orange Ration Cards, farmers from distressed districts, and vulnerable families.
policies.premium_structure: 100% premium paid by the State Government.

policies.name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
policies.coverage_details: Monthly pension support of ₹1,500 to individuals incapable of earning their livelihood.
policies.target_audience: Destitute persons, blind, disabled, orphans, and women suffering from critical illnesses below poverty line.

policies.name: Yeshasvini Health Insurance Scheme
policies.coverage_details: Cashless medical insurance coverage for over 2,100 surgical procedures at network hospitals.
policies.target_audience: Rural and urban cooperative society members, farmers, and peasants in Karnataka.
policies.premium_structure: Subsidized low-cost contribution with state backing.

policies.name: Anna Bhagya Scheme (Ration Welfare)
policies.coverage_details: Distribution of 5 kg of free rice per person per month along with cash transfers (DBT) for the additional 5 kg component.
policies.target_audience: Below Poverty Line (BPL) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cardholders.

policies.name: Mukhyamantri Amrutam (MA) Yojana
policies.coverage_details: Family floater health insurance coverage up to ₹3 Lakh per annum for tertiary care and critical illnesses (cardiac, renal, neuro, burns).
policies.target_audience: Lower-income groups and families living below the poverty line in Gujarat.
policies.premium_structure: Fully funded by the Gujarat State Government.

policies.name: Anna Brahma Yojana
policies.coverage_details: Provision of free food grains to eligible marginalized beneficiaries who do not have a stable source of income.
policies.target_audience: Migrant laborers and poorest citizens without formal document access.

policies.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
policies.coverage_details: Cashless health care up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary/tertiary hospitalisation.
policies.target_audience: Residents of Tamil Nadu with an annual household income below specified limits.
policies.premium_structure: 100% premium borne by the State Government.

policies.name: Universal Public Distribution System (UPDS)
policies.coverage_details: Supply of free rice to all rice-option ration cardholders alongside highly subsidized sugar, pulses, and oil.
policies.target_audience: All eligible resident cardholders of Tamil Nadu without strict income distinctions.

policies.name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (MAAY)
policies.coverage_details: Universal health insurance model providing cashless insurance coverage of up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care medical conditions.
policies.target_audience: All permanent resident families of Rajasthan (Free for BPL, NFSA, and small farmers; nominal subscription for others).
policies.premium_structure: Fully funded or subsidized by the State Government depending on tier.

policies.name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP)
policies.coverage_details: Secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year, aligned concurrently with central frameworks.
policies.target_audience: Poor, marginalized, and vulnerable families residing across Kerala.
